agent_summary: Cortisol, thyroid hormones and lactate/hypoglycaemia are NOT gaps: each has 5 to 8 independent canine severity or outcome units (cortisol and T4 mostly Onderstepoort B. rossi: CB040, CH31, CB342, CH09, plus CB486 or CH35 from B. canis; lactate in B. rossi, B. canis and B. gibsoni). The two gaps are the kynurenine pathway (serum kynurenine measured only infected vs healthy in B. canis, CB091; canine LC-MS/MS method validated; IDO1/KMO in DS06, per-dog metabolite tables in public supplements S-CB091/S-CB071) and copeptin/vasopressin (never measured in canine babesiosis; canine ELISA used but its agreement with AVP is doubtful). Of 5 grade >=2 mechanisms, 2 (40%) are gaps. Surprises: adrenal androgens (DHEA) have never been measured in dogs with babesiosis, and the Onderstepoort endocrine units may share patients.

mechanisms.human_direction: higher basal cortisol in non-survivors (sepsis); adrenal androgens and ratios mostly not independent

mechanisms.testable_detail: DS06 has NR3C1 (glucocorticoid receptor, whole-blood gene expression, not the hormone); no DS07 master; cortisol not in DS02
mechanisms.notes: 5 units: CB040, CH31 (CB338+CB352), CB342, CH09 (CB105), CB486 (B. canis). 4 of 5 are Onderstepoort B. rossi; CB040 (2006-2016 patients) and CB342 (2007) may share patients with CH31, which cohorts.json does not resolve. Untested parts: adrenal androgens (never measured) and the cortisol:ACTH ratio (tested once by outcome, CB352, null). Assay graded validated as standard canine clinical endocrine immunoassays; no separate validation DOI retrieved.

mechanisms.testable_detail: DS07 master E2R5U8 (TTR, transthyretin, 16% coverage): a thyroid hormone carrier, not T4/T3 itself; SERPINA7 not found; no thyroid hormone in DS02 or DS06
mechanisms.notes: 5 units: CB040, CH31, CB342, CH09 (all Onderstepoort B. rossi, possible patient overlap as for F6-01) and CH35 (Warsaw B. canis). CH37 adds a within-infected correlation with azotaemia. T3 is the least tested by outcome. TTR in DS07 is an indirect proxy that can be tested now.

mechanisms.testable_detail: DS02 has lactate and glucose (5 experimental B. rossi Beagles with clinical scores); no DS07 master; LDHA not in DS06 lookup
mechanisms.notes: 8 units with a severity or outcome contrast: CB040, CH21, CH18, CH08, CB486, CB537, CH33, CB112 (CB112 circular). Lactate alone: 4 units (CB040, CH21, CH18, CH08) in B. rossi, B. canis and B. gibsoni, all higher with death. Pre-2006 Onderstepoort lactate and hypoglycaemia studies are outside the review window and not counted.

mechanisms.testable_detail: DS06 has IDO1 and KMO (whole-blood gene expression in the 5 B. rossi Beagles, not circulating metabolite). Outside DS02/06/07: public supplements S-CB091 (serum kynurenine and tryptophan per dog, infected vs healthy only) and S-CB071 (urine, kynurenine and kynurenic acid as annotated untargeted features, by kidney-function groups A/B/C) could give a first renal-severity contrast
mechanisms.notes: Gap confirmed: one PubMed hit for dog babesiosis (CB091, infected vs healthy). Canine LC-MS/MS method for kynurenine and tryptophan validated (2026); IDO activity raised in canine pyometra. The vasodilatory role (10.1038/nm.2092) fits B. rossi hypotension. Not covered by HU001-HU027.

mechanisms.human_direction: higher copeptin in sepsis non-survivors (two meta-analyses); in imported malaria copeptin is only a weak marker of severity (AUC 0.66, n=204) or not related to it

mechanisms.testable_detail: AVP not in DS06 lookup; no DS07 master; not in DS02. Needs archived serum (canine or human copeptin ELISA)
mechanisms.notes: Gap confirmed: no dog babesiosis study measured copeptin or AVP (CB044 suspected SIADH without measuring it). Assay caveat: serum copeptin tracked osmotic stimulation in Beagles (10.1111/jvim.70219), but an ELISA agreed poorly with ADH in cardiac dogs (10.3390/ani15071013), so graded used_in_dogs, not validated. Human malaria evidence is weak; the grade rests on sepsis.
